policy.source: FC 010: every row of the CI dashboard is computed from the evidence[] below (JUnit test files or describe blocks, gate script exit codes, CI job results). The dashboard never reads status.
policy.status: Kept for verifyL only (R-OWASP-EVIDENCE): PASSED means evidence[] is wired and green in CI; N/A needs Ω notes.
policy.RESERVED_SLOT: method=reserved: the surface does not exist yet. Shown as ⏸️ RESERVED SLOT only while its guard evidence passes; FAILED when the guard fails; NOT_VERIFIED when it did not run.
policy.certificate: T2: every module PASSED or RESERVED SLOT and every category PASSED or valid RESERVED SLOT, otherwise the certification job exits 1.

A01.label: Broken Access Control
A01.notes: Closed inventory of public API routes (printRoutes), 404 problem for anything else, CORS for https://yekora.mx only. No accounts or privileged actions exist yet (see A07).

A02.label: Cryptographic Failures
A02.notes: Authenticated backups (AES-256-GCM, scrypt), TruffleHog on every push, HSTS checked by e2e/htaccess.spec.ts on Apache. HTTP→HTTPS 301 is done by Hostinger's CDN.

A03.label: Injection (SQL/NoSQL)
A03.notes: Static, parameterized SQL only (AST guard with per-call allowlist); Zod validation before any query.

A04.label: Insecure Design (controles SDLC Protocolo L)
A04.notes: Signed FC, threat notes and truth tables; rate limits on the API.

A05.label: Security Misconfiguration
A05.notes: Helmet and RFC 7807 errors without internals on the API; CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, no listing and branded 404 on Apache.

A06.label: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
A06.notes: Blocking audit: critical = 0 and high = 0, dated exceptions; frozen lockfile in every job.

A07.label: Identification/Auth Failures
A07.notes: Ω (2026-10-19, 076_AN §6): the surface does not exist — no authentication, users, sessions or passwords in the public catalog and guest cart. RESERVED SLOT while 'A07 surface absent' passes; it activates with the first auth route or plugin (K-05/K-07), which fails that guard on purpose.

A08.label: Software & Data Integrity Failures (pipeline)
A08.notes: Actions pinned by SHA, lockfile in sync, deploy only after certification, migrations manual-only on the reserved runner.

A09.label: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
A09.notes: Rejections (400, 404, 429) and server failures leave a JSON trail; credentials never reach the log.

A10.label: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
A10.notes: The only outbound call is the fixed Banxico SIE URL, with a timeout; no user-supplied URL is ever fetched.
